title: MeeseeksHypothesis
description: A testable hypothesis for the RSI loop system. Hypotheses drive the reasoning process - they're what we test to build confidence.

hypothesis.description: The hypothesis statement - what we believe might be true

test_method.description: How to test this hypothesis - specific actions/probes to run

expected_outcome.description: What we expect to see if the hypothesis is true

null_outcome.description: What we'd see if the hypothesis is FALSE (helps design better tests)

probe_type.description: Type of probe best suited to test this

dependencies.description: Other hypothesis IDs this depends on

blocks.description: Hypothesis IDs that this blocks (can't test until this resolves)

tools_required.description: Tools needed to test this hypothesis

estimated_time_seconds.description: Estimated time to test this hypothesis

risk_if_untested.description: Risk level if we proceed without testing this

dissent_source.description: Dissent ID that prompted this hypothesis (if any)

test_result.description: Result after testing (filled in when tested)

dissents_generated.description: New dissents raised from testing this

follow_up_hypotheses.description: New hypotheses generated from this result

examples.hypothesis: Adding tests to module Y will reveal hidden bugs that could affect feature X
examples.test_method: Run new tests against module Y and check for failures
examples.expected_outcome: 0-2 failures maximum, indicating module is stable

examples.hypothesis: The API contract of module Y matches what feature X expects
examples.test_method: Generate TypeScript types from Y's API and compare to X's imports
examples.expected_outcome: Types should match with no conflicts
examples.null_outcome: Type mismatches would indicate integration risk

examples.hypothesis: There exists a simpler implementation path that bypasses module Y entirely
examples.test_method: Council vote on alternative architectures with pros/cons analysis
examples.expected_outcome: At least one viable alternative identified
examples.null_outcome: No alternatives - must use module Y
